scientific_integrity: Existing torus embedding and affine group are explicitly attributed as prior art; finite computations are supplied with standalone reproducible code.
scientific_limitations: Exact determination is for the Paley graph of order 13 only, for simple unoriented four-edge cycles and their mod-two H1 classes. It does not calculate the full integral marked length spectrum or claim independent review.
title: Three balanced homology classes of shortest cycles in the Paley-13 flag torus
